notes: Found: the lift's load model still used a 30 mm flight base plate that the welded-cleat change removed (and that could not wrap a 16-tooth pulley); a cleat alone would raise per-ball pull 0.70 to 1.30 N, full-belt 10.5 to 19.4 N. Built a printed cap with a loose trailing pad (arm 15.0 mm derived, pad length set by the pulley sweep), jam and weld checks, a CAD part (STL in the package), and a test turning it round both pulleys. Verification: cad tests 126 passed (397 s, build123d 0.13.0 venv); run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots ok (426.6 s); feeder package regenerated, manifest collisions [] and design_rules []; venture-preflight rerun after the record.
